newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to issue stamp to fund breast cancer research.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to issue stamp to fund breast cancer research.

text.p: The U.S. Postal Service will issue special, more expensive first-class stamps to help fund breast cancer research, the White House said Wednesday.
Under legislation signed into law by President Clinton on Wednesday, the Postal Service has 12 months to design and distribute the stamps, a Postal Service spokesman said.
The agency has not decided the cost of the stamp, he added, saying the law stipulates that it can be no more than 25 percent, or eight cents, above the normal 32 cents.
The extra revenue will go to breast cancer research carried out by the National Institutes of Health and the Defense Department after the Postal Service deducts administrative costs, he said.
